Whisper Notes: Transcribe speech into text using the Whisper model.

- High accuracy and fast speech-to-text tool.
- No internet, meaning your voice and text privacy won't be leaked to anyone.
- Supports over 80 languages and mixed-language scenarios.

No subscription/in-app purchases/ads, just a one-time payment for lifetime use.

You can use it for voice note-taking, capturing inspiration, or to transcribe long speeches into text to send to friends, with accuracy far surpassing system voice recognition.


■ Why make this?

There are already many tools based on Whisper in the market, so why make another one? The intention is simple:

1. Sometimes I have a bizarre dream and want to record it when I wake up, but it's hard to type with sleepy eyes. I wish for a tool that can quickly input and transcribe speech.

2. When friends send me messages requiring lengthy replies, and I'm either on the street or eating, I wish to reply quickly without responding with voice messages.

Therefore, this product strikes a balance between accuracy and speed: using the largest model possible without having to wait minutes to complete transcription. Normally, you input a speech, wait a few seconds, and then copy the text to reply. If you seek ultimate accuracy (which results in very slow transcription), Whisper Notes might not be suitable for you.
